item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-06
item.description: DeepSeek's no-KPI organizational model challenges China's 996 culture; CAC's 94-article internet rulebook draft introduces AI chapter and gig worker protections; CCF China Open Source Conference 2026 announces subforums; Shanghai's open-source platform plan; OpenAtom Foundation expands into Hong Kong; Apache Foundation sees surge in China-contributed projects.
